components.name: Main Landing Gear Shock Strut
components.function: Absorbs and dissipates the energy generated during landing and ground operations.
components.description: The main landing gear shock strut is a structural component that absorbs landing loads using hydraulic fluid and compressed gas. It reduces the loads transmitted from the wheels to the aircraft structure.

components.name: Main Landing Gear Wheel
components.function: Supports the aircraft weight and provides the mounting interface for the tire and brake assembly.
components.description: The main landing gear wheel supports high static and dynamic loads during landing, taxiing, braking, and takeoff.

components.name: Main Landing Gear Brake
components.function: Converts the aircraft's kinetic energy into heat during braking.
components.description: The main landing gear brake is installed on the main wheels and provides the braking force required to decelerate the aircraft after landing and during taxi operations.

components.name: Main Landing Gear Side Stay
components.function: Provides structural support and helps maintain the landing gear in the extended or retracted position.
components.description: The side stay is a structural link that transfers loads within the landing gear assembly and contributes to the locking mechanism when the landing gear is extended.

components.name: Main Landing Gear Axle
components.function: Supports the main landing gear wheels and transfers loads between the wheels and landing gear structure.
components.description: The main landing gear axle is a highly loaded structural component designed to withstand vertical, lateral, and braking loads during aircraft ground operations.

components.name: Main Landing Gear Torque Link
components.function: Controls the relative rotation between sections of the landing gear shock strut.
components.description: The torque link assembly connects different sections of the shock strut and maintains the correct alignment of the landing gear during operation.

components.name: Nose Landing Gear Shock Strut
components.function: Absorbs vertical loads generated during nose gear touchdown and ground operations.
components.description: The nose landing gear shock strut absorbs and dissipates energy during landing and taxiing while providing structural support between the aircraft and nose wheels.

components.name: Nose Landing Gear Wheel
components.function: Supports the front section of the aircraft and allows the aircraft to roll during ground operations.
components.description: The nose landing gear wheels support a portion of the aircraft weight and are used during taxiing, takeoff, and landing operations.

components.name: Nose Wheel Steering Actuator
components.function: Controls the direction of the nose landing gear during ground operations.
components.description: The steering actuator converts hydraulic input into movement of the nose landing gear, allowing the aircraft to change direction while taxiing.

components.name: Nose Landing Gear Torque Link
components.function: Controls the relative rotation of the inner and outer shock strut cylinders.
components.description: The torque link assembly connects the upper and lower portions of the nose landing gear shock strut and helps maintain proper wheel alignment.

components.name: Nose Landing Gear Fork
components.function: Connects the nose wheels to the landing gear structure and supports the wheel axle.
components.description: The nose landing gear fork is a structural component that supports the nose wheels and transfers ground loads into the landing gear assembly.

components.name: Nose Landing Gear Drag Brace
components.function: Provides longitudinal structural support and transfers loads within the nose landing gear assembly.
components.description: The drag brace is a structural link that helps maintain the geometry of the nose landing gear and transfers longitudinal loads during ground operations.

components.name: Tail Wheel Assembly
components.function: Supports the rear section of an aircraft during ground operations.
components.description: A tail wheel assembly is installed at the rear of aircraft equipped with conventional landing gear. It supports the tail section and allows the aircraft to move while taxiing.

components.name: Tail Wheel Fork
components.function: Supports and connects the tail wheel to the tail landing gear structure.
components.description: The tail wheel fork provides the structural connection between the aircraft and the tail wheel and allows the wheel to rotate during ground operations.

components.name: Tail Landing Gear Shock Absorber
components.function: Absorbs loads and vibrations transmitted through the tail landing gear.
components.description: The tail landing gear shock absorber reduces the loads transmitted to the aircraft structure during landing, taxiing, and other ground operations.
